_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - never loaded. Copy to openshare.ci.config.json (gitignored), fill in your deployment's values, and seal as the OPENSHARE_CONFIG_JSON secret: gh secret set OPENSHARE_CONFIG_JSON < .github/plugins/openshare.ci.config.json (run from a minified copy: jq -c . openshare.ci.config.json | gh secret set OPENSHARE_CONFIG_JSON). Absent secret = live sharing disabled, passive artifacts still produced. Recommended token: a scoped CI token (reaches only its own shares), minted from your user's full token via POST /api/token {"kind":"scoped"}.
